description.narrative: The objective of the Grant is two-fold: (1) support for establishment of an institutional framework for internal audit, and (2) capacity building of the internal audit methodology and assessment units at the Ministry of Finance and Economy and selected internal audit units. Specifically the Grant will support the Internal Audit Development Department (IADD) to (i) establish a legal framework for public sector internal audit function, (ii) increase the awareness of the strategy implementation, and (iii) capacity building of IADD staff as well as decentralized internal audit staff in conducting internal audits that would help provide the skills needed to implement in practice the methodology to be developed. The grant will also support the proposed phased approach to reform the Financial Supervision Department (FSD) and build capacity in the Internal Audit Assessment Department (IAAD), in tandem with the on-going treasury and external audit reforms, and start the process of preparing decentralized audit units at least on the pilot agencies and line ministry level for a long term role as a modern internal audit units within Government agencies. As part of the first steps towards establishment of an internal audit system the grant will support translation and adaptation of auditing standards and development of auditing methodology, training of the key staff at the IADD and IAAD, as well as training of the key staff from the government agencies internal audit units to enable them acquire skills and abilities to develop modern internal audit functions. The grant will support implementation of initial steps of the long-term strategy and time bound action plan to bring the internal control framework into compliance with international standards, which would drive much wider reform in the public sector internal audit which in its turn will result in establishment of modern internal audit system in the whole public sector.
